svg.text: Front, three-quarter right, three-quarter left, back. Dark mask, lit slash sigil, six spine plates. Working labels, placeholder design, pending Legal review.
Body 88 units to the top of the head, head 17.8 units: about 4.9 heads tall
The signature crouch (the Coil), the pose in play
Build: compact and coiled. Torso 0.87, legs 0.84, arms 0.95, head 1.06 of the
Staging: the game shows three-quarter, mirrored when the fighter faces left, so the
left view is the right view mirrored. The front and back are for modelling and
turnarounds and are not staged in play. In the crouch the front view is
foreshortened, so it is left to the real model.
The value rule: dark body, light gear. Body #2a2043, gear #cbd3e2, accent #9a80d8,
Front features (harness, buckle, belt plate) sit on the front surface. Back features
(spine plates, belt, tail) sit on the back surface. The sigil is the only face.
Legal conditions kept: no shoulder pads with white gloves and boots, no flame or
upswept hair, no hair-colour change, no gold or red glow, no cape.
Forms F1 to F6: one spine plate per form (three-quarter, upright)
Wear: fresh, bruised, battered, broken (three-quarter, upright)
The mask: neutral, taunt, hurt, rage, triumph (three-quarter), and the back of the head
Part list for the model (near LOD, about 1,700 triangles against the 2,500 budget)
Blank wedge mask, dark obsidian. A sigil decal slot (an emissive slash and dot). No face rig.
A cap over the skull and a short tied tail on a 3-bone spring chain. Never changes colour or shape with form.
A dark bodysuit. Compact: torso 0.87 of the standard height.
One diagonal sash and a round buckle with a small diamond stud. Never two crossing straps, and no slash on the chest, so nothing makes an X with the face slash. Fr..
Six rounded slabs down the spine, one per form (F1 nape to F6 hip). Rigid, parented to the spine bones. Each toggles by form and swaps to a cracked variant with co..
A wide plate at the hip. Front and back.
Upper arm and forearm each. From form 4 the near forearm takes two guards, from form 6 three.
Small rounded plates, toggled by form.
Closed fists. Open variants for taunt and guard.
Thigh and shin each, short (0.84 of standard).
Palette masks: red channel body, green gear, blue accent, alpha the emissive sigil. Bones,
about 24: root, pelvis, two spine, neck, head, three tail (spring), two shoulders, upper
arms, forearms, hands, thighs, shins, feet. The plates are rigid children of the spine
bones. Wear is five floats (head, core, arms, legs, crown). Regalia pieces are separate
meshes with an intact and a broken variant.
